mode_question: zero-touch deployment: zero local wifi-iface, manager owns the 4-way

definitions.join: /interface wifi capsman remote-cap contains an entry for OpenWrt-CAP3 (state, address, connected-time present).
definitions.manager reports state=Ok: that remote-cap entry has state="Ok" (not Connecting/Error).
definitions.manager has a registration row for the S: /interface wifi registration-table has a row for the STA MAC; this is the manager's view, independent of hostapd's local view.
definitions.CAP holds no PSK (manager owns the 4-way: every hostapd BSS carries external_rsn_auth=1 and no real wpa_passphrase (only a placeholder); the RSN state machine is the manager's.
definitions.8/8 VAPs: Two radios x four BSS (1 master + 3 slaves) provisioned by the manager and present as netdevs on the CAP: phy0-ap0..3 (2.4 GHz) and phy1-ap0..3 (5 GHz).
definitions.VAP up on the CAP: netdev exists; iw reports type AP; operstate=up; ifindex>0; the netdev is enslaved to its expected br-vlanXX bridge; hostapd's generated config maps that BSS to the same bridge.
definitions.manager started the VAP (0x6016): the manager sent CAPsMAN v2 TYPE_START (0x6016) for that VAP's port and capagent acknowledged with 0xE016. Port encoding: radio0 0x0000..0x0003, radio1 0x0100..0x0103.
definitions.real STA associated: iw station dump on a VAP shows associated=yes/authenticated=yes and the manager registration-table contains the STA MAC.
definitions.4-way complete: iw station dump shows authorized=yes AND the manager row is authorized, with the CAP log showing 0x201b/0x201c/0x201f for the peer.
definitions.DHCP on the right VLAN: the manager's DHCP server of the VLAN bound to that SSID has a bound lease for the STA MAC in that VLAN's subnet (cap-test vlan30 10.0.30/24, cap-guest vlan10 10.0.100/24, cap-iot vlan20 10.0.120/24, cap-hidden vlan99 10.0.0/24).
definitions.ping passes: the manager can ping the leased STA address (3 probes, >=1 reply).
definitions.classic local wifi-iface layout: /etc/config/wireless owns the BSSes (classic deployment): at least eight wifi-iface sections covering cap-hidden/test/guest/iot.
definitions.classic CAP-local RSN: the CAP holds the PSK and hostapd completes the 4-way locally; this is the expected classic-mode behaviour and is accepted here.
definitions.zero local wifi-iface: /etc/config/wireless has wifi-device sections only; the manager is the sole source of every SSID, VLAN and security setting.
definitions.no injection to a stale ifindex: 0x201c EAPOL TX must never target an ifindex whose netdev was recreated; a cached port map is re-resolved from the live ifname / BSSID before injection.

pass_rules.join: remote-cap has an entry for OpenWrt-CAP3 with an address and connected-time
pass_rules.manager_state_ok: that entry's state field is exactly 'Ok'
pass_rules.vaps_defined: exactly 8 /interface wifi objects are bound to OpenWrt-CAP3
pass_rules.vaps_up: all 8 phyX-apN exist, are type AP, operstate=up, ifindex>0, enslaved to the expected br-vlanXX, and the last sample is still 8/8
pass_rules.vap_start_0x6016: the CAP log contains RX 0x6016 start port=0x0000..0x0003 and 0x0100..0x0103
pass_rules.sta_associate: iw station dump reports associated=yes and authenticated=yes for the selected STA
pass_rules.manager_registration: /interface wifi registration-table has a row for the STA MAC
pass_rules.cap_psk_free: every hostapd BSS has external_rsn_auth=1 and no real wpa_passphrase (only a placeholder)
pass_rules.fourway: authorized=yes AND a manager registration row AND 0x201f NEW_KEY PAIRWISE>0 AND zero hostapd-local EAPOL-4WAY-HS-COMPLETED events
pass_rules.dhcp_vlan: a bound manager DHCP lease for the STA MAC lies inside the SSID's VLAN subnet
pass_rules.ping: the manager's ping to that lease receives at least one reply
pass_rules.stale_ifindex_fix: no '0x201c: inject ... ret=-19' in the log window; if a port was re-resolved it is logged as 'pmap: ... refreshed'
